beats.line: I can't tell you whether to buy Diginex shares.
beats.headline: NOT ADVICE
beats.action: A cream evidence folder drops onto open violet ground and a paper hand slides it forward, then withdraws.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] I can't tell you whether to buy Diginex shares.

beats.line: My role is surfacing the evidence, so you decide.
beats.headline: YOU DECIDE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the evidence folder opens and fans torn paper strips across the ground, where they settle in a row; the black ribbon to the paper hand stays in place.
beats.delivery: My role is surfacing the evidence, so you decide.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent, to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the torn strips stack upward into the paper bar chart, its tallest bar locking at the top; a green ribbon runs from the bar chart to stacked paper rulebooks, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$2.0M' sits beside the ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent, to two million dollars.

beats.line: New disclosure rules are creating structural demand globally.
beats.headline: REGULATORY TAILWIND
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper bar chart holds and the stacked paper rulebooks at the ribbon's far end pile higher over a flat paper map; the green ribbon stays in place.
beats.delivery: New disclosure rules are creating structural demand globally.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise added thirteen point eight million in cash.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the stacked rulebooks flatten into taped paper coins that pile beside the paper bar chart and hold; the green ribbon remains strung between them.
beats.delivery: October's warrant exercise added thirteen point eight million in cash.

beats.line: At that burn, cash covered roughly one point four months.
beats.headline: 1.4 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the coin stack shrinks coin by coin onto a short paper calendar strip that tears off after its second page; an orange string runs from the coin stack to the calendar strip, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.85M' sits beside it, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] At that burn, cash covered roughly one point four months.

beats.line: Four acquisitions pushed general costs to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the right edge as the paper calendar strip folds into stacked paper folders that pile four high beside the coin stack and press it down; the orange string stays in place.
beats.delivery: Four acquisitions pushed general costs to eight point one million.

beats.line: Resulticks is unclosed; Findings and Kindred have stalled.
beats.headline: DEALS STALLED
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the stacked paper folders unfold into string and pins, three pins driven in and the string pulled taut then left slack beside the coin stack; the orange string to the calendar strip stays in place.
beats.delivery: Resulticks is unclosed; Findings and Kindred have stalled.

beats.line: Demand cross-sell traction and a closed Resulticks deal.
beats.headline: EVIDENCE NEEDED
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the pinned string reels in and straightens into a paper checklist; a paper hand taps two hole-punched tags onto its lines, and a cream ribbon runs from the paper checklist toward the frame's edge.
beats.delivery: Demand cross-sell traction and a closed Resulticks deal.

beats.line: This is a high-risk bet on execution, not defensive.
beats.headline: HIGH-RISK BET
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the paper checklist folds back into the cream evidence folder at the cream ribbon's end; a rubber stamp presses down once and lifts, leaving the folder closed and holding.
beats.delivery: This is a high-risk bet on execution, not defensive.
